evidence: Live credentials: regex scan of the whole frozen task for provider key shapes (sk-, AKIA, ghp_, xox*, AIza, sk_live/pk_live, Bearer tokens, PEM private-key blocks) returned zero hits. task.toml:30-35 [verifier.env] uses ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN = "${OPENROUTER_API_KEY}" and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY = "" (template form; diff vs template task.toml shows only name/description/keywords/metadata changes). The only password is the documented demo password `Hireops!2026` (instruction.md:17, hireops_rules.md:11, tests/app_context.md:8), which SKILL.md Known false positives explicitly allows; seed_data.json users carry no password field (db.js:66 inserts a shared demo pw at seed time) and contains no credential. Solution session tokens are runtime crypto.randomBytes (src/index.js:88), not committed secrets. Personal data: every email in the task uses RFC 2606 reserved domains (21x hireops.example, 13x candidates.example, 12x mail.example, 1x local.invalid in the template Dockerfile git config); no phone, SSN, address or DOB patterns found. Names (Rafael Costa, Noor Haddad, etc.) are generic synthetic personas tied to .example mailboxes; message/note bodies are generic recruiting boilerplate ('Thanks for sending that over. (#001)'). Host paths: no Windows drive paths, /home/, /Users/, or workspace names (turing-workspace) anywhere in the task; all paths are container paths (/app, /assets, /instructions, /tests). Remote fetch: the solution makes no outbound request (no http(s).get, child_process, external fetch; index.html loads only /js/board.js, /js/threads.js, /js/app.js locally); package.json pins express 5.1.0 and better-sqlite3 12.4.1; solve.sh only copies files. The only URLs are localhost:3000/127.0.0.1:3000 and https://openrouter.ai/api in the frozen verifier block. environment/Dockerfile is byte-identical to the template and tests/Dockerfile, test.sh, score.py, restart_mcp.py, .dockerignore show no diff vs template; their npm/pip installs are version-pinned (express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1, @anthropic-ai/claude-code@2.1.281, @playwright/mcp@0.0.79, harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7). Base images are tag- not digest-pinned and apt packages unversioned, but these are template-controlled and public network is the delivery profile. Injection payloads: scan for 'ignore previous', 'system prompt', 'disregard', full-marks/score-steering phrases, <script>, javascript:, onerror=, DROP TABLE across seed data, instructions and prompts found nothing except the solution's own local <script src> tags. The single reject_reason ('Portfolio did not show shipped product work.') and three notes are plain text. Adversarial angle: a submission cannot exploit any committed secret (none exists), and a weak app gains nothing from task data; a conforming alternative is not penalised by this row. Static row: no runtime evidence is required, so no measurement is missing.
